description: This Kotlin file defines a UI fragment HomeFragment for an Android application, which extends BrowseSupportFragment to display multiple rows of workout-related content, badges, profile info, and search functionality. It manages UI setup, data population from a MockRepository, and event handling for interactions.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a home screen with multiple rows such as workouts, progress, badges, and profile options using Android Leanback library.

classes.name: StringPresenter
classes.description: An inner class extending Presenter to create simple clickable cards labeled 'Open' with customized appearance.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up UI, builds content rows, and event listeners.

methods.name: setupUi
methods.description: Configures the header, title, colors, and search button of the fragment.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Constructs various content rows including workouts, progress charts, badges, and profile options.

methods.name: setupEventListeners
methods.description: Sets click listeners for row items to handle user interactions such as opening workout details or profile.

methods.name: openProfile
methods.description: Launches the ProfileFragment as a dialog.

methods.name: openGoals
methods.description: Launches the GoalsFragment as a dialog.
